newsitem.title: UK: Racal says sales show modest growth in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Racal says sales show modest growth in Q1.

text.p: Racal Electronics Plc said on Wednesday that there has been modest growth in both sales and orders in the first three months of the year.
"The improvement has been particularly marked in both defence electronics and specialised businesses," chairman Sir Ernest Harrison told the company's annual meeting.
Racal announced in June pre-tax profits slipped to 40.4 million stg in the year to March 31, 1997 from 70.4 million last year.
The company also launched a drive to increase shareholder value in June, focusing on telecommunications, data products and defence electronics.
Racal had been under pressure to come up with a new strategy following a 30 percent slump in its share price in the last year and a series of profit warnings.
By 1205 GMT, shares in Racal were quoted 2p lower to 223p.
